item.title: Errand Saver: One-Time Visits
item.description: One-hour visit that includes fresh food and water refills, enclosure/litter cleaning, playtime and enrichment activities. Perfect for under 3 day visits.

item.title: Peace of Mind: Multi-day Visits
item.description: Perfect for routine and worry-free visits, love and care for your furry (or feathery, or scaly) friend! For visits over 4 days or more.

item.title: Home-Alone Hero: All Day Visits
item.description: For extended in-home care when you’re out all day. Includes everything in your chosen package, with additional feeding, playtime, and bathroom breaks throughout the day.
